en: \[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls failing in organizations without the Claude GitHub App; they now use your connected GitHub account and say so when none is connected
zh: \[Claude Code on the web] 修复了在未安装 Claude GitHub App 的组织中 `gh` 和 GitHub API 调用失败的问题；现在它们会使用你已连接的 GitHub 账户，并在未连接任何账户时明确提示
